description: This script is designed for managing prebuilt tools within an OpenWRT build environment. It handles tasks such as extracting prebuilt tool tarballs, refreshing timestamps to avoid unnecessary recompilation, and updating directory stamps. It also provides command-line options for setting directories and installing tools.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Refreshes the timestamps of all non-symlink files within a specified directory.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts a tar archive of prebuilt tools.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of directories to avoid unnecessary rebuilds, verifying directory existence first.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts the prebuilt tools tarball and refreshes timestamps.
